The six frontend-performance audit reports have been merged and structured into `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs/frontend-perf/PRIORITIZED.md`.

### Summary of Ledger
- **Packets Created (9 disjoint packets)**:
  - `P-settings-runtime-bridge` (`ui/src/lib/settingsRuntimeBridge.ts`): Remove global document subtree MutationObserver.
  - `P-terminal-backlog-buffer` (`ui/src/lib/terminalEvents.ts`): Replace monolithic 512KB string concatenation with chunked buffer.
  - `P-terminal-base64-decode` (`ui/src/lib/terminalOutput.ts`): Vectorize/optimize base64 decode loop for PTY output bursts.
  - `P-root-code-splitting` (`ui/src/main.tsx`): Code-split `App` and `RemoteApp` with `React.lazy` and `Suspense`.
  - `P-workspace-app-store` (`ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`, `ui/src/App.tsx`, `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`): Memoize selectors, stabilize window close guard & shortcut listener dependencies, and lazy-load `SettingsDialog`.
  - `P-tab-bar-memo` (`ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx`, `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SortableTab.tsx`): Memoize `SortableTab` and tab list context to eliminate tab strip re-render churn.
  - `P-sidebar-worktree-list` (`ui/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`, `ui/src/components/WorktreeList.tsx`): Pre-index active agents to $O(1)$ and eliminate per-render allocations.
  - `P-terminal-pane-lifecycle` (`ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx`, `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts`, `ui/src/lib/terminalSettings.ts`): Consolidate ResizeObservers and eliminate chained rAF double-fit passes.
  - `P-terminal-split-dnd` (`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`): Replace $O(K \cdot \log K \cdot N)$ droppable lookups in drag collision detection with $O(1)$ container map.

- **Deferred**:
  - `F-shell-04`: CommandPalette unvirtualized list (ephemeral modal with small item counts).
  - `F-remote-02`: RemoteTerminal `new TextEncoder()` per keystroke in `sendKey` (micro-allocation).
  - `F-bundle-02`: Dead SVG favicon link in `ui/index.html` (non-blocking 404 in dev mode).
  - Vite `server.watch.usePolling`: Development-only file-watcher configuration (accepted).
  - Baseline pre-existing test suite failures (accepted per constraints).

- **Dropped**: None (all findings verified in codebase).

`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs/frontend-perf/PRIORITIZED.md` has been written with the prioritized, disjoint fix-packet ledger covering all High and Medium findings across the six audit lanes, with exclusive write scopes, proofs, invariants, deferred items, and dropped items.
